conclusion: Unified metrics and adapted-reference parity verified for the evaluated local models; no EV-SpSegNet Validation comparison is available.

protocol.aggregation: sum event/target/component counts before division; no macro averaging
protocol.event_support: all original events, including proposal-rejected events with probability 0
protocol.localization_timestamp: ev_loc -> int64 -> float32, same as official collate/test
protocol.fa_mask: uint8 increments modulo 256, 8-connectivity, once per frame
protocol.threshold_policy: each model's pre-frozen threshold; no Validation fitting
reference_adaptations: OpenCV component count uses independent union-find if cv2 is absent

official_ev_spsegnet.reason: Official checkpoint absent and CUDA/spconv/HAIS_OP inference environment unavailable; paper Test score is not a Validation measurement.
